nodes.label: IRST UTC+03:30 Timezone & BiDi Numerical Isolation
nodes.norm_label: irst utc+03:30 timezone & bidi numerical isolation
nodes.rationale: Guarantees accurate Iranian calendar day boundaries without DST drift (fixed +03:30) and prevents RTL inversion of negative signs, currency prefixes, percentages, and Canvas 2D labels via .bidi-num and Canvas LTR overrides.

nodes.label: Localhost Security Boundaries (CSWSH, DNS Rebinding & Trade Guardrails)
nodes.norm_label: localhost security boundaries (cswsh, dns rebinding & trade guardrails)
nodes.rationale: Protects local financial data and TRADE endpoints from malicious browser tabs and DNS rebinding using /ws Origin checks (close 1008), TrustedHostMiddleware, Origin validation on POST/PUT/DELETE, confirm_all=true on bulk cancel-old, and Decimal serialization.

nodes.label: Offline TradingView Advanced v28 & Symbol/Timeframe Integrity
nodes.norm_label: offline tradingview advanced v28 & symbol/timeframe integrity
nodes.rationale: Provides full professional charting offline via TradingView Advanced v28 while isolating localStorage settings so URL symbols take precedence and terminating 1W/historical pagination cleanly with { noData: true }.

nodes.label: Dedicated Orders Sync Cursor & Spot/Margin Self-Healing
nodes.norm_label: dedicated orders sync cursor & spot/margin self-healing
nodes.rationale: Separates orders_sync_cursor_id from open-order/WS inserts so intermediate Margin orders are never skipped, supports descending single-page fromId pagination, and repairs trade Spot/Margin tags via POST /market/orders/status.

nodes.label: Spot Equity Curve Isolation & Cash Completeness
nodes.norm_label: spot equity curve isolation & cash completeness
nodes.rationale: Keeps Spot equity curve free of leveraged futures distortion and missing-deposit fiat withdrawal skew while including RLS/IRT, DAI, and USDT cash balances so fiat-to-stablecoin conversions do not cause artificial portfolio value jumps.

nodes.label: SQLite Connection Lifecycle, Indexing & Streaming Export
nodes.norm_label: sqlite connection lifecycle, indexing & streaming export
nodes.rationale: Prevents file-descriptor leaks and WAL growth caused by Python sqlite3.Connection context managers not closing connections, via @contextmanager conn.close(), 6 secondary indexes, atomic reconcile_open_orders, batched IN queries, single-query get_stats, and streaming CSV export.

nodes.label: True Net PnL Accounting Model
nodes.rationale: Computes true trader profitability by deducting buy/sell fees in spot and cumulative 8-hour extensionFee from Nobitex API PNL/unrealizedPNL in margin without double-deducting open_fee, close_fee, or poolPNLShare.

nodes.label: 180-Day WAC Replay & Unmatched Sell Filtering
nodes.rationale: Prevents phantom PnL, volume, and cost-basis distortion from Nobitex's 180-day /market/trades/list cutoff and off-exchange/wallet crypto withdrawals by ignoring unmatched sells, deducting confirmed withdrawals chronologically in WAC, and splitting partial_history vs flat holdings.

nodes.label: Zero-Build Modular ES Frontend & Offline Bundling
nodes.norm_label: zero-build modular es frontend & offline bundling
nodes.rationale: Eliminates code duplication, race conditions (via AbortController), and timer/AudioContext leaks from a 3,382-line inline script by splitting into native ES modules (api, utils, calendar, calculator, ws) while preserving offline-first zero-Node single-command Python execution.

nodes.label: Spot-Isolated Equity Curve & BTC Benchmark
nodes.rationale: Tracks continuous spot account growth from first spot execution free of futures leverage or fiat transfer distortion, comparing against BTC benchmark while computing MDD, Peak Equity, Alpha, and URL-persisted date presets.

nodes.label: Persian Docs: Spot-Isolated Equity Curve & BTC Benchmark
nodes.norm_label: persian docs: spot-isolated equity curve & btc benchmark
nodes.rationale: Documents 100% spot-isolated cumulative equity curve excluding futures multipliers and fiat bank withdrawals, continuous timeline from first spot trade, BTC benchmark alpha overlay, and URL-persisted date presets.

nodes.label: Persian Docs: Liquidation Risk Radar & Margin Controls
nodes.norm_label: persian docs: liquidation risk radar & margin controls
nodes.rationale: Documents real-time mark-to-liquidation distance alerts (Safe/Caution/Danger), confirmation-gated collateral edits and position closes (TRADE permission), and offline Web Audio API alert chimes.

nodes.label: Persian Docs: Open Orders Management
nodes.rationale: Documents live WebSocket Spot/Margin open orders filtering by market and buy/sell direction with single and bulk (/api/orders/cancel-old) confirmation-gated cancellation.

nodes.label: Persian Docs: Daily PnL Calendar (Jalali & Gregorian)
nodes.norm_label: persian docs: daily pnl calendar (jalali & gregorian)
nodes.rationale: Documents color-coded monthly PnL grid combining spot executions and USDT/IRT closed margin positions with Jalali/Gregorian calendar modes and Day Inspector.

nodes.label: Persian Docs: True Net PnL & Live WebSocket Asset Valuation
nodes.norm_label: persian docs: true net pnl & live websocket asset valuation
nodes.rationale: Documents exact Decimal True Net PnL (deducting fees, 8h renewal fees, and pool share without double-counting), crypto withdrawal WAC replay, safe ignoring of pre-180d unmatched sells, live ws://127.0.0.1:8080/ws valuation for USDT/DAI/RLS/crypto/margin, dual USDT/IRT display, and Asset Details modal.

nodes.rationale: Documents Python 3.12+ setup via uv sync, .env Read-Only vs TRADE key configuration, running nob-web on 127.0.0.1:8080, and running pytest and ruff.

nodes.label: Persian Docs: Privacy & Security Architecture
nodes.rationale: Documents local-only SQLite storage (data/portfolio.db), .gitignore secret protection, zero external CDNs, offline zero-build frontend modules (src/nob/static/js/), TrustedHostMiddleware, and Origin validation on /ws and TRADE endpoints against CSWSH and DNS rebinding.

nodes.label: Persian Docs: Trading Journal & Net Amount Column
nodes.norm_label: persian docs: trading journal & net amount column
nodes.rationale: Documents buy Net Amount (Amount - Fee) tracking, technical strategy tags, and trading psychology state logging.

nodes.label: Persian Docs: Offline TradingView Charting Engine
nodes.norm_label: persian docs: offline tradingview charting engine
nodes.rationale: Documents local TradingView Advanced v28 without cloud dependencies, 15m-1W timeframes, bounded cache, live WS candles, URL sync, and Jalali/Gregorian chart timeline.

nodes.label: Persian Docs: 1920px Widescreen & BiDi Numerical Isolation
nodes.norm_label: persian docs: 1920px widescreen & bidi numerical isolation
nodes.rationale: Documents 1920px widescreen layout optimization and .bidi-num plus Canvas 2D LTR enforcement for accurate RTL number rendering.

nodes.label: Liquidation Risk Radar & Margin Controls
nodes.rationale: Monitors live mark-to-liquidation distance across Safe (>20%), Caution (10-20%), and High Danger (<10%) tiers with toggleable Web Audio API chimes and confirmation-gated Add/Edit Collateral and Close Position actions (TRADE permission).

nodes.label: Nobitex Open Orders Management
nodes.rationale: Lists live Spot and Margin open orders (Active, New, Inactive) via WebSocket with market/side filters, single or confirmation-gated bulk cancellation (/api/orders/cancel-old), and embedded Asset Details orders.

nodes.label: Daily PnL Calendar & Day Inspector
nodes.rationale: Visualizes daily realized spot and USDT/IRT closed margin performance on a dual Jalali/Gregorian monthly grid with click-through Day Inspector for settled trades and positions.

nodes.label: Portfolio & Asset Overview (Decimal Valuation & Asset Details Modal)
nodes.norm_label: portfolio & asset overview (decimal valuation & asset details modal)
nodes.rationale: Aggregates spot balances (USDT, DAI, RLS/IRT, crypto) and margin collateral with live ws://127.0.0.1:8080/ws prices (REST fallback) using Decimal True Net PnL, 180-day WAC integrity, dual USDT/IRT display, and a 7-column spot-isolated Asset Details modal.

nodes.label: Position Size & Risk Calculator
nodes.rationale: Enforces capital protection by computing exact position size from risk tolerance ($ or % equity) and stop distance, recommending safe leverage beyond stop-loss, flagging liquidation/stop-loss collisions, and copying trade plans in one click.

nodes.label: Project Structure & Module Layout
nodes.rationale: Organizes backend Python modules (db, nobitex_client, pnl, server, ws_bridge, time_utils), zero-build offline SPA static assets (index.html, i18n.js, js/, vendor/), pytest suite, data/, and graphify-out/ with .graphifyignore excluding minified vendor assets.

nodes.label: Quickstart, Configuration & Automated Testing
nodes.rationale: Enables rapid local setup on Python 3.12+ using uv sync, .env Read-Only or TRADE API credentials, uv run nob-web on 127.0.0.1:8080, and verification with pytest and ruff.

nodes.label: Privacy & Security Architecture (Offline-First & Localhost Hardening)
nodes.rationale: Ensures financial privacy and localhost API safety via local SQLite storage (data/portfolio.db), .gitignore credential protection, zero external CDNs/telemetry, TrustedHostMiddleware, WS Origin CSWSH validation, confirm_all guardrails, fail-fast 403 on read-only keys, and closed SQLite connections.

nodes.label: Trading Journal & Strategy Playbook
nodes.rationale: Builds trading discipline by tagging technical setups and psychology states, tracking Net Amount (Amount - Fee for buys), and filtering trade history by tag to evaluate setup profitability.

nodes.label: Offline TradingView Advanced Charting Engine
nodes.rationale: Delivers 100+ indicators and drawing tools offline with TradingView v28 across 15m/30m/1h/4h/1D/1W candles, bounded server cache, live /ws candle streaming, bi-directional URL sync, isolated localStorage, and Jalali/Gregorian timeline.

nodes.label: Widescreen 1920px Layout & BiDi Isolation
nodes.rationale: Utilizes 2K/4K/Ultrawide horizontal space with max-w-[1920px] containers and max-w-5xl modals while preserving RTL numerical readability via .bidi-num and Canvas 2D LTR enforcement.

nodes.label: ADR-001: Removal of Hardcoded 17 Oct Cutoff Date
nodes.norm_label: adr-001: removal of hardcoded 17 oct cutoff date
nodes.rationale: Hardcoded 2026-10-17 cutoff excluded older user trades in an open-source project and became stale over time; replaced with optional user-controlled URL date-range presets (All Time, 30D, 90D, YTD, Custom) in db.py, pnl.py, server.py, and UI.

nodes.label: ADR-002: Net Amount Column Calculation for Buy Trades
nodes.norm_label: adr-002: net amount column calculation for buy trades
nodes.rationale: Nobitex deducts spot buy fees from the purchased crypto asset itself (net_amount = ROUND(MAX(0.0, amount - fee), 8)), whereas sell fees are deducted from received quote currency (USDT/IRT), so sell net_amount must remain NULL (dash).

nodes.label: ADR-003: True Net PnL After All Fees and Pool Share
nodes.norm_label: adr-003: true net pnl after all fees and pool share
nodes.rationale: Gross PnL misleads leveraged traders; Nobitex API PNL/unrealizedPNL already deducts open_fee, close_fee, and poolPNLShare, while 8-hour extensionFee is charged separately (tp='fee') and for open positions represents per-period rate, so pnl.py computes API_PNL - Cumulative_Extension_Fee without double-deduction.

nodes.label: ADR-004: Offline TradingView Advanced Charting Library
nodes.norm_label: adr-004: offline tradingview advanced charting library
nodes.rationale: KLineCharts and TradingView Lightweight lacked professional drawing tools and analytical indicators; TradingView Advanced Charting Library v28 was bundled 100% locally in src/nob/static/vendor/tradingview/ fed by /api/chart/candles and /api/chart/symbols.

nodes.label: ADR-005: TradingView Symbol URL Sync and LocalStorage Isolation
nodes.norm_label: adr-005: tradingview symbol url sync and localstorage isolation
nodes.rationale: TradingView restored tradingview.chartproperties from browser localStorage and overwrote URL symbol parameters; resolved via load_last_chart: false, auto_save_delay: 0, disabling localStorage chart settings features, onChartReady hook, and chartSymbol watcher calling setSymbol().

nodes.label: ADR-006: 1W Timeframe Resolution and Pagination Loop Termination
nodes.norm_label: adr-006: 1w timeframe resolution and pagination loop termination
nodes.rationale: Selecting 1W froze the chart due to W vs 1W resolution mismatch in server.py and infinite history pagination; fixed by normalizing W/1W and returning { noData: true } in getBars when no bars older than 'to' exist.

nodes.label: ADR-007: Widescreen Layout Optimization (max-w-[1920px])
nodes.rationale: max-w-7xl (1280px) wasted over 50% width on 2K/4K/Ultrawide monitors and cramped 12-column financial tables; #app container expanded to max-w-[1920px] and asset details modal expanded to max-w-5xl (1024px).

nodes.label: ADR-008: Bidirectional URL State Synchronization
nodes.rationale: Page refreshes previously reset active tabs, filters, and symbols; bidirectional sync via history.replaceState persists tab, symbol, tf, from, to, calMode, date, and q for deep linking and reload persistence.

nodes.label: ADR-009: Open Orders Tab with In-App Cancellation
nodes.norm_label: adr-009: open orders tab with in-app cancellation
nodes.rationale: Managing limit/stop orders previously required switching to the Nobitex website; added /api/orders/open tab, modal order view, and optimistic /api/orders/cancel (requiring TRADE API permission, while Read-Only keys remain protected).

nodes.label: ADR-010: Strict Iran Standard Time (IRST / UTC+03:30, No DST)
nodes.norm_label: adr-010: strict iran standard time (irst / utc+03:30, no dst)
nodes.rationale: Iran abolished DST in 1401 SH, fixing official time at UTC+03:30 year-round; dynamic OS/library timezones caused 1-hour shifts in history and Jalali calendar day bucketing, so server and client enforce fixed +03:30.

nodes.label: ADR-011: BiDi Numerical Isolation and Canvas 2D LTR Override
nodes.norm_label: adr-011: bidi numerical isolation and canvas 2d ltr override
nodes.rationale: In Persian RTL mode, signs, currency symbols, and percentages (e.g. -$189.51, +3.79%) inverted visually and Canvas 2D tooltips/axes reversed text; fixed with .bidi-num (direction: ltr; unicode-bidi: isolate) and CanvasRenderingContext2D fillText/measureText LTR overrides.

nodes.label: ADR-012: Offline-First Architecture and Zero External Telemetry
nodes.norm_label: adr-012: offline-first architecture and zero external telemetry
nodes.rationale: Financial history, API keys, and personal strategy notes are strictly confidential; all frontend libraries (Vue 3, Tailwind, Chart.js, Jalaali.js, TradingView v28) and fonts (Vazirmatn, JetBrains Mono) are bundled locally with zero external CDNs or telemetry.

nodes.label: ADR-013: Spot Equity Curve Isolation and Elimination of Fiat Cashflow Distortion
nodes.norm_label: adr-013: spot equity curve isolation and elimination of fiat cashflow distortion
nodes.rationale: Including leveraged past_positions and un-paired bank withdrawals distorted initial_equity to >$10,800 and shifted start date back to 2025; isolating Spot equity curve (include_futures=False, include_cashflows=False), anchoring All Time to first spot trade, removing VIP header badges, and defaulting bank deposits to RLS in upsert_cashflows restores accurate ~$1,256 equity scale.

nodes.label: ADR-014: 180-Day API Cutoff, Crypto Withdrawal WAC Replay, Margin/Spot Sync & Spot Cash Completeness
nodes.norm_label: adr-014: 180-day api cutoff, crypto withdrawal wac replay, margin/spot sync & spot cash completeness
nodes.rationale: Nobitex /market/trades/list returns only 180 days, crypto withdrawals reduce spot holdings, MAX(orders.id) cursor skipped intermediate Margin orders, and RLS/DAI cash was omitted from spot allocation; resolved by ignoring unmatched pre-180d sells, replaying confirmed crypto withdrawals in WAC, tracking partial_history/flat holdings, adding dedicated orders_sync_cursor_id + /market/orders/status self-healing, and including RLS/IRT, DAI, USDT in spot portfolio and modal filtering.

nodes.label: ADR-015: Localhost Security Boundaries, SQLite Lifecycle, Async Concurrency & Zero-Build Modular Frontend
nodes.norm_label: adr-015: localhost security boundaries, sqlite lifecycle, async concurrency & zero-build modular frontend
nodes.rationale: Hardened localhost against CSWSH and DNS rebinding (Origin checks on /ws and mutating HTTP endpoints, TrustedHostMiddleware, confirm_all on cancel-old, Decimal non-scientific formatting), prevented SQLite FD/WAL leaks via @contextmanager conn.close() and 6 indexes, eliminated thread/WS races via threading.local() Session, locks, 2s broadcast timeout, 10m cooldowns, immutable WAC replay, and modularized the 3,382-line JS block into zero-build ES modules keeping ADR-012 single-command Python execution plus pytest/ruff checks.
